summary: Frontend-only verification of the new daily-habit features (Inicio member-daily-panel, Bienestar water tracker + Auto smart-goal + streak + reminders, Calculadora persists sn_peso). Logged in as admin compratendencia0@gmail.com and executed the full flow end-to-end via Playwright against the public preview URL. RESULTS: (1) Inicio panel [data-testid=member-daily-panel] renders at the top with 3 cards linking to /bienestar, /calculadora, /mi-menu; shows greeting + current weekday + Agua vasos/meta + calorías (— when no calc) + Menú de hoy (comidas or 'Genera tu menú semanal'). (2) After Calculadora submit with peso=70, localStorage.sn_peso='70' and sn_calorias JSON both stored; Inicio panel then shows 2507 kcal/día. (3) Bienestar water-add-1/2/3 correctly increment (0→1→3→6), water-minus decrements (6→5), water-reset zeros. (4) 'Auto' [water-auto-meta] with peso=70 sets meta to 10 vasos (matches expected ~10 for 70kg formula peso*35/250). (5) After filling water to 12 (>=10 meta), the streak element [water-streak] appears on Bienestar reload showing '🔥 Racha de 1 día cumpliendo tu meta' and the '¡Meta cumplida! 🎉' message. (6) Reminders card [reminders-card] lists all 5 reminders (desayuno, menu, almuerzo, agua, cena) with time inputs and toggles [reminder-toggle-*] that persist to localStorage.sn_reminders. All 6 review-request items PASS.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking water-add-N the streak indicator does not appear immediately even when today's vasos become >= meta. Root cause: add() updates only water.vasos in local state, not water.semana, so the streak calculation (which reads water.semana[0].vasos) still sees the stale value from initial GET /water. The streak correctly appears after a page reload/refetch. Suggested fix: after add()/reset(), either call loadWater() again OR update the semana entry for today in local state so the streak reflects live progress.

issues: On very fast navigations from Bienestar → Inicio the panel briefly shows the pre-fetch '0 / meta' before the /water GET resolves (observed once). Not a bug, cosmetic only — could show a skeleton/loader on the vasos value instead of defaulting to 0.

action_items: (LOW) In /app/frontend/src/pages/Bienestar.jsx, after api.post('/water/add') / '/water/reset', also refresh the semana (either call loadWater() or optimistically update the today entry inside water.semana) so the '🔥 Racha' indicator becomes visible without requiring a page reload.
(Optional cosmetic) Show a placeholder/skeleton in Landing.jsx MemberPanel Agua-de-hoy card while water is null instead of rendering '0 / meta'.
critical_code_review_comments: Bienestar.jsx add()/reset() do a partial state update ({...w, vasos}) that leaves water.semana stale — this is the direct cause of the streak-not-updating UX issue. Prefer calling loadWater() (already defined) after mutations, or update the today entry inside semana explicitly.

Landing.jsx MemberPanel reads sn_agua_meta / sn_calorias from localStorage on render but does not re-read on storage events; if a user updates the calculator in another tab the panel won't refresh until navigation. Minor.

Streak computation iterates byDate sorted DESC and breaks on first day below meta — correct algorithm. However today's not-yet-completed day will always break the streak; consider skipping today when it is still below meta so previously-completed days can still show a positive streak.

reminders scheduling uses setTimeout with a single-day horizon — if the tab stays open past midnight, no reminder will fire the next day. Consider re-arming timers on a daily interval or on visibilitychange.
MemberPanel silently swallows GET /water and /menu errors (.catch(() => {})) with no user feedback — acceptable for a dashboard tile, but a subtle 'No se pudo cargar' hint would improve UX.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 requested flows verified against the public preview URL. Only remaining concern is that the water streak does not render live after add() because Bienestar.jsx doesn't refresh water.semana; a single-line fix (call loadWater() after add/reset) resolves it. Backend /api/water endpoints returned correct values throughout (verified via curl: {vasos:12, semana:[{fecha:2026-09-06, vasos:12}]}).
rca of the issue: Streak-not-visible after clicks: Bienestar.jsx uses `setWater((w) => ({ ...w, vasos: data.vasos }))` in add()/reset(); the streak IIFE reads `water.semana` which is never updated, so today's cached semana entry (vasos=0 from initial GET) always fails the `d.vasos >= meta` check and returns streak=0. On a full page reload GET /water is called fresh, semana[0].vasos becomes 12, and the streak renders correctly. Fix: after every add/reset, either call `loadWater()` or splice the today entry inside water.semana with the new vasos value.
